sections.title: Sound of A
paragraphs: You call this letter (A) /ə/. Its most common sound is the sound /æ/, as in the word (apple) /æ.pəl/, which means an apple. This letter makes four different sounds in English words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, drop your jaw wide and spread your lips. For the next sound, move your jaw up slightly while your tongue glides forward. For the third sound, keep your tongue completely relaxed in the middle of your mouth. For the final sound, open your mouth wide and keep your tongue flat at the bottom. Put your hand on your throat to feel your voice buzz for all four.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In a closed syllable, this letter sounds like the sound /æ/, as in the word (cat) /kæt/. In an open stressed syllable or before silent final e, it sounds like the sound /eɪ/, as in (lake) /leɪk/. In an unstressed syllable, it sounds like the quick sound /ə/, as in (about) /ə.baʊt/. Before certain consonants, it makes the long back sound /ɑː/, as in (father) /fɑː.ðər/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not mix up the short front sound with a simple flat ah. For the sound in (map) /mæp/, you must open your jaw wider and pull your lips sideways. Do not make the sound in (sofa) /soʊ.fə/ too long or clear, but keep it very short and relaxed. In (spa) /spɑː/, remember to drop your jaw and keep the sound deep.
